notes: Exchange trading and custody (GDD 7.5, 7.6). Read by sim/market.gd and sim/custody.gd. The historical price never moves; liquidity limits only change the player's fill price.

sell_cap_fraction_of_volume.note: The most the player can sell (or buy) in a day, as a share of that day's real exchange volume (volume_btc in btc_daily.csv).

slippage_per_volume_share.note: The marginal fill moves against the player by this times the share of the day's volume traded so far. Selling 10% of the day's volume: the last coin fills 5% below the close, 2.5% below on average.

cold_to_exchange_days.note: GDD 7.6: cold coins take one game day to reach the exchange.

exchange_to_cold_days.note: Withdrawals take a day too. Coins in flight to or from a failing exchange are lost with it.

exchanges.note: Exchanges the player can use in Acts 1-2, by placeholder counterparty id (parody names TBD). exchange_tier1 (Mt. Gox class) opens with the mtgox_launch event and fails with mtgox_halts_withdrawals. exchange_tier4 (Bitstamp class) launched in August 2011 (source); 2011-08-18 is its first daily candle in tools/raw. It kept operating through 2014 and 2016.

wallet_loss_enabled.note: Optional: an unbacked cold wallet can be lost (dead disk). Off by default; one free backup command removes the risk.

wallet_loss_daily_probability.note: About a 17% chance over a year without a backup, when enabled.
